candidates.event: Early-August Federal Charter; conventional origin, without an attested day

entities.reason: The charter renews an older agreement. Government explains that its founding-document status emerged in the late nineteenth century and discusses unresolved origin interpretation. Ask whether to adopt the conventional 1291 origin or retain a blank. August 1 is a later national-day choice, not the documented signing day; 1848 is a constitutional change.

candidates.event: Personal dynastic union of Castilian and Aragonese crowns

entities.reason: Education Ministry says the 1469 marriage and 1479 crown union preserved separate laws and institutions and did not unify the crowns.
